data_description.utility: The company whose online usage pages are provided by Silverblaze. Not listed? See "Supported utilities" in the README.

data_description.username: The username (usually your email) for your utility's online account.
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage and included in HA backups. Only sent to your utility.

history.title: Usage history
history.description:
{utility_name} has hourly usage for this account from {history_start}.

You can change this later in the integration's settings. Changing it later never deletes hours already imported.

history_unknown.title: Usage history
history_unknown.description: You can change this later in the integration's settings. Changing it later never deletes hours already imported.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Only usage from this date on will be imported. Earlier hours are skipped. You can change this later in the integration's settings; changing it never deletes hours already imported.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {utility_name}
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} no longer works. Enter your current {utility_name} password.

error.login_flow_changed: Your utility's login flow changed in a way this version does not understand. Check for an integration update.
error.interval_out_of_range: Choose a value between 6 and 24 hours.
error.date_in_future: Pick a date on or before today.

create_entry.default: Your usage history is being imported in the background. It can take several minutes before it appears in the Energy dashboard.

init.title: Silverblaze (Idaho Power) options
init.description: Changing or removing the start date never deletes hours already imported.

data_description.import_from: Only import usage from this date on. Once a date is saved, the previous menu shows an option labeled "Import all available history" that imports everything your utility still has. Changing this date never deletes hours already imported; to remove old hours, use Developer tools > Statistics.
data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to check for new data (6-24). Your utility publishes usage about 2-4 days late.

import_all.title: Import all available history
import_all.description: This removes your "Import history from" date (currently {current_date}). Nothing you have already imported is deleted. Right after you confirm, any earlier usage your utility still has is added to your Energy history. This can take a few minutes.

error.interval_out_of_range: Choose a value between 6 and 24 hours.
error.date_in_future: Pick a date on or before today.

cannot_connect.message: Failed to connect to Idaho Power or Silverblaze; will retry on the next update.

login_flow_changed.message: Your utility's login flow changed in a way this version does not understand. Check for an integration update.
